# WAS_PolynomialRegression { #wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression }

```python
WAS_PolynomialRegression(nb_cores=1, degree=2, dist_method='nonparam')
```

Polynomial Regression model for spatiotemporal climate prediction.

Implements polynomial feature expansion (PolynomialFeatures + LinearRegression)
to capture non-linear relationships between predictors and a continuous predictand.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                | Description                                                    | Default     |
|-------------|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| nb_cores    | int                 | Number of CPU cores for parallel Dask computation.             | `1`         |
| degree      | int                 | Degree of the polynomial expansion (2 = quadratic, 3 = cubic). | `2`         |
| dist_method | (bestfit, nonparam) | Tercile probability method.                                    | `'bestfit'` |

## Warnings {.doc-section .doc-section-warnings}

- degree ≥ 4 with many features causes numerical instability; prefer degree 2–3.
- Predictors should be normalised externally before calling this class.
- Negative predictions are clipped to zero (suitable for rainfall / non-negative
  variables; remove the clip for temperature or anomalies).

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit](#wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit) | Tercile probabilities using best-fit climatological distribution family. |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric](#wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric) | Non-parametric tercile probabilities from historical error samples. |
| [compute_model](#wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.compute_model) | Parallel polynomial regression across the full (Y, X) domain. |
| [compute_prob](#wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.compute_prob) | Tercile probabilities for a deterministic hindcast. |
| [fit_predict](#wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.fit_predict) | Fit polynomial regression on one grid cell, return [error, prediction]. |
| [forecast](#wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.forecast) | End-to-end single-year forecast: deterministic prediction + tercile probabilities. |
| [weibull_shape_solver](#wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.weibull_shape_solver) | Root function for the Weibull shape parameter k given mean M and variance V. |

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit { #wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit }

```python

    best_guess,
    error_variance,
    T1,
    T2,
    dist_code,
    dof,
)
```

Tercile probabilities using best-fit climatological distribution family.

FIX 1 – scalar clip: use np.maximum instead of item-assignment on a

### forecast { #wass2s.WAS_PolynomialRegression.forecast }

```python

    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,

    hindcast_det,

    best_code_da=None,
```
